# uptimecheck_alert_channel (Resource)

An alert channel: where alerts are sent. For the types that need only their address or key; SMS, phone calls, Telegram, push and Add to Slack are set up in the app and can be read with the uptimecheck_alert_channels data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "uptimecheck_alert_channel" "slack" {
  type   = "slack"
  name   = "#ops"
  config = { webhookUrl = var.slack_webhook_url }
}

# Escalation: the inbox hears about an outage that has lasted 15 minutes.
resource "uptimecheck_alert_channel" "inbox" {
  type          = "email"
  name          = "On-call inbox"
  is_default    = false
  delay_minutes = 15
  config        = { to = "oncall@example.com" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Map of String, Sensitive) Where alerts go, by type. email: to (up to 10 addresses, separated by commas). slack, teams, discord, google_chat, mattermost: webhookUrl. pagerduty: routingKey. ntfy: topicUrl, and token for a protected topic. pushover: userKey and appToken. webhook: url. The API never returns these, so a change made in the app isn't seen as drift.
- `name` (String) Shown in the app, at most 60 characters.
- `type` (String) One of [email slack teams discord google_chat mattermost pagerduty ntfy pushover webhook]. Changing it replaces the channel.

### Optional

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Escalation: how long an outage lasts before this channel is alerted (0, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60).
- `enabled` (Boolean) false pauses the channel and drops the alerts waiting for it.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Attached to monitors created without channel_ids.

### Read-Only

- `hint` (String) A short, non-secret trace of the address, as the app shows it.
- `id` (String) The alert channel's id (ch_…).
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) webhook only: the secret that signs each delivery. The API returns it once, at creation, so it is empty for an imported channel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An alert channel is imported by its id. Its config and a webhook's signing secret aren't read back.
terraform import uptimecheck_alert_channel.slack ch_...
```
